fnol_text: My name is Esther Osei and I live at 528 Sycamore Road, Clinton, NC 28375. You can reach me on (555) 440-4687 or esther.osei@example.com. On 29 April 2025 flash flooding came down the street while my car was parked at home. Water got into the cabin and the engine won't start. Policy MT-2025-00066. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Osei on (555) 440-4687 to acknowledge the claim. Esther confirmed the loss date as 29 April 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Felix Ueda gave a statement by phone.
Esther sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
